
Two arXiv papers from the RSS scout are strong candidates: FlowEvo addresses self-evolving agentic workflows with co-evolution of workflow structure and executable skills (architectural patterns, tool-use lifecycle, iterative refinement, empirical grounding), and Coupled Hierarchical Search over Topology and Execution for Agentic Workflow Synthesis directly targets workflow synthesis architecture with hierarchical search over execution patterns.

## Suggestions

- [FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21596) — Proposes a co-evolution framework where agentic workflows and executable skills mutually adapt over time, addressing dynamic workflow architecture, tool-use lifecycle design, and iterative self-refinement with empirical evaluation.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (patterns, orchestration, state management), Tool-use and execution design across agent lifecycle stages (planning, execution, feedback, recovery), Iterative refinement practices (evaluation loops, human-in-the-loop, observability), Empirical or practical grounding (case studies, benchmarks, production deployment evidence)

- [Coupled Hierarchical Search over Topology and Execution for Agentic Workflow Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21609) — Introduces a coupled hierarchical search framework that jointly optimizes workflow topology and execution strategies for agentic workflow synthesis, with direct implications for orchestration design and multi-step execution planning.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (patterns, orchestration, state management), Tool-use and execution design across agent lifecycle stages (planning, execution, feedback, recovery), Empirical or practical grounding (case studies, benchmarks, production deployment evidence)
